Based on the provided fiscal year 2025 Q4 financial data, the issuer exhibits an exceptionally strong credit profile characterized by robust profitability (42% operating margin, 68% gross margin, and $8.5B net income), a solid balance sheet with low leverage ($81.3B in equity supporting $171.1B in assets), and a very healthy liquidity position represented by a 1.71 current ratio ($31.6B in current assets vs. $18.5B in current liabilities). This extremely low default risk, combined with massive scale ($18B in annual revenue and $171B in assets), warrants a high investment-grade rating in the AA category, but just shy of the absolute maximum rating due to the presence of $89.8B in total liabilities.

DECISION: AA
